Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Lady Constancia's text:
"You may burn the Edge and spend a discard phase action to discard a card at
random and draw its replacement from the other cards in your ash heap."

Just one simple question:
Do I have to choose the replacement card before the random card is chosen?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. You simply draw its replacement from the other cards in your ash heap.

So, while you can't draw the discarded card back, you can base your decision of
which card to draw on the knowledge of which card was discarded.

Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
>> Jozxyqk wrote:
>>> Lady Constancia's text:
>>> "You may burn the Edge and spend a discard phase action to discard a card at
>>> random and draw its replacement from the other cards in your ash heap."
>>>
>>> Just one simple question:
>>> Do I have to choose the replacement card before the random card is chosen?
>
>> No. You simply draw its replacement from the other cards in your ash heap.
>
>> So, while you can't draw the discarded card back, you can base your decision of
>> which card to draw on the knowledge of which card was discarded.
>
> Thanks..
> OK, more questions about her ability, now that I thought about it some more:
>
> 1) Can you use her ability if you otherwise would not be replacing a discarded
> card (i.e. if your library is empty) ?

Yes. Since your "hand size" would be greater than the number of cards you're
holding, you'd be continuously looking to replace the card at the first
opportunity. From the ash heap is fine for that opportunity.

> 2) Can you use her ability if you have an empty library *and* no cards in
> hand (to just draw a card from your ash heap)?

You can use her ability to burn the Edge (costing a DPA), but that won't get you
a draw from the ash heap, since you only draw "its replacement" from the ash heap.

> 3) Can I combine her ability with Rachel Brandywine's ability (i.e. can I
> shuffle the randomly-discarded card back into my library, if I control both
> of those vamps) ?

Yes. That's just card text.

> 4) If there were some hypothetical way to regain the edge during one's discard
> phase, would her ability be usable multiple times in the same turn?

If you had sufficient DPAs, sure. Just like you can use the ability of a Short
Term Investment multiple times in the same turn if you can get sufficient MPAs.

No, since it says nothing about overriding the delay.

> If not, do I still replace the card by drawing from my ash heap during my
> untap phase?

No. Her ability only functions when you discard the card. If the replacement
doesn't occur at that time, then you don't get to use the special replacement
(and instead, when the time comes to replace the card, you draw it from the top
of the library as normal).
